# ANALYSIS: BASELINE_J_ANCHOR_PERFORMANCE

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** baseline_establishment
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We aim to establish the baseline performance of the current engine on the J anchor days (OP-16 source-of-truth) and on a broader set (for Sharpe) to compute edge_capture and aggregate_sharpe. This baseline serves as the reference for evaluating all strategy candidates.

## Mechanism

No change to the engine. We run the current engine (as defined by automation/state/params.json and automation/state/aggressive/params.json) on the J anchor days and on a broader historical set (for Sharpe) using the autoresearch grinder harness. The engine operates with its existing parameters, triggers, filters, and exit logic.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The baseline engine uses the current params in automation/state/params.json (Safe account). For qty=28, requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.
2. **Sample bias:** The J anchor days are 6 specific days (3 winners, 3 losers) selected by J as source-of-truth. Overfit risk: low because these are fixed and not used in optimization.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (held-out window not yet established; requires Stage-1 backtest with walk-forward validation)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not yet validated against real OPRA fills)
5. **Failure modes:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (e.g., worst day, max drawdown, blow-up scenario)
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (if top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X)

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>
Stage-1 backtest must complete and produce validated edge_capture and Sharpe metrics. Gym validators must pass. Walk-forward OOS Sharpe must be computable. Real-fills validation on top 3 J days must show <±20% deviation from BS-sim.

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- We have a reference point from the leaderboard (base edge_capture=780, Sharpe=4.340) but we have not run the Stage-1 backtest ourselves to confirm. The baseline may have drifted since the leaderboard was last updated.
